matches.note: GOLD for 17-year-old Kumkum Mohod: from 3–5 down she shot a perfect 30 in the fifth set (5–5) and won the shoot-off 10–8 against South Korea's Yejin Oh. First Indian woman to win an Asian Games individual recurve medal; both finalists earn LA28 quota places.

matches.note: India retain men's gold, beating Pakistan by 19 runs. Abhishek Sharma 61 (28), Tilak Varma 51* (22) and Shivam Dube 27 (15) made 211/6; Hasan Nawaz hit 96 (51) for Pakistan, who finished 192/6. India's women also won cricket gold.

src.t: Business Standard – India edge past Pakistan to defend gold

matches.note: India beat Malaysia 5–1 to retain the title — the first time India have defended Asian Games hockey gold, and their fifth overall. Harmanpreet Singh scored twice (PCs), with Jugraj Singh, Hardik Singh (penalty stroke) and Shilanand Lakra; Malaysia equalised early in the first quarter. India qualify for LA 2028.

matches.note: West Indies won by 5 wickets with a record ODI chase of 352. Shai Hope made 162* (143) — his 21st ODI hundred — and Amir Jangoo 67; Jayden Seales took 3/62. KL Rahul's 129* (87) and Rohit Sharma's 92 went in vain. India win the series 2–1.
